assumptions.description: Service minimum replicas at assumed average traffic
Peak rates already listed per flow; queue backpressure monitored
N+1 / recovery analysis; P12 single instance has an explicit availability gap
Re-measure demand and re-size replicas; no linear price promise

nodes.label: External model (provider and exact version to be selected)
Agent read-only and data minimization controls
Peak link capacity / p95 hop latency targets
Verified completed lot or order outcome

edges.label: Farmer synchronization via intermittently connected mobile
Hosted model invocation; no raw identity fields
External OCR request for scanned dossier
Lot persistence (logical write payload, not DB replication)
